learning_outcomes.text: Expresses general information about transport machines.
Makes the design of transport machine systems.

syllabus_topics: Material handling systems and their classification, determination of transport systems design project working groups.
Wire ropes and chains, research and evaluation of transport systems design project study topics.
Sheaves of wire rope and chain and hoisting block and tackle, research and evaluation of transport systems design project study topics.
Drums of wire rope and chain.
Calculation of load hoisting systems, determination and detailing of transport systems design project study subjects.
Brakes and brake releasing devices. Brakes and calculation of braking torque
Moving systems on rail and power calculation.
Design of belt conveyors, evaluation of the complete and detailed drawings of the transport systems design project.
Screw conveyors, vibrating conveyors and chain conveyors, evaluation of the complete and detailed drawings of the transport systems design project.
